clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, Brewmaster Drohn seeks a Thunder Lizard Horn for Chen Stormstout's legendary brew.

Thunder lizards roam the Barrens, their crested bodies crackling with lightning. Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet values their horns as an ingredient for Stormstout ale. His mentor learned the recipe from the wandering pandaren Brewmaster Chen Stormstout and passed it down to Drohn. The horn gives the drink its potent kick.
